prompt: Which statement is logically equivalent to 'if you pass, you studied'?

options.text: If you did not study, you did not pass
If you did not pass, you did not study
If you passed, you did not study

explanation: The contrapositive of 'P implies Q' is 'not Q implies not P'. Here P is 'you pass' and Q is 'you studied', so the equivalent form is 'if you did not study, you did not pass'.
